methodology.protocol: Fold 1 selects one fixed temporal analogue configuration; folds [2, 3, 4] are untouched.
methodology.causality: Only analogue outcomes with target_at strictly before the query observed_at enter memory.
methodology.admission: At least 70% market and asset accuracy, market Wilson low at least 65%, and every final fold and asset at least 60%.

oracle_market_factor_ceiling.description: Diagnostic only: asset direction when the future cross-asset market direction is known. This is not a tradable predictor.
